```{=html}
<style>
.w4{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
.w4-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;background:#fafafa;margin-bottom:10px;align-items:end}
.w4-top label{font-size:12px;color:#555;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.w4-top select,.w4-top input{padding:5px 6px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px}
.w4-top input[type=range]{width:220px}
.w4-pill{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.w4-panels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.w4-panels canvas{width:100%;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #eee;background:#fff}
.w4-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px}
.w4-card{text-align:center;padding:12px 8px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#f8f8f8}
.w4-card .w4-val{font-size:1.5em;font-weight:700}
.w4-card .w4-lbl{font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-top:2px}
@media(max-width:600px){.w4-panels{grid-template-columns:1fr}.w4-info{grid-template-columns:1fr}.w4-top input[type=range]{width:140px}}
</style>

<div class="w4" id="w4">
  <div class="w4-top">
    <label>Paramètre à varier
      <select id="w4-param">
        <option value="p">Prix métal (p)</option>
        <option value="k">Coût fonderie (k)</option>
        <option value="m">Coût minage (m)</option>
        <option value="h">Coût traitement (h)</option>
        <option value="y">Récupération (y)</option>
        <option value="f">Frais fixes (f)</option>
        <option value="F">Coût opportunité (F)</option>
        <option value="M">Capacité mine (M)</option>
        <option value="H" selected>Capacité trait. (H)</option>
        <option value="K">Capacité marché (K)</option>
        <option value="moyenne">Moyenne (%)</option>
        <option value="variance">Variance (%²)</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>Valeur
      <input type="range" id="w4-slider" min="0" max="100" step="1" value="50">
    </label>
    <span class="w4-pill" id="w4-pval">—</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w4-panels">
    <canvas id="w4-cv1" width="390" height="320"></canvas>
    <canvas id="w4-cv2" width="390" height="320"></canvas>
  </div>
  <div class="w4-info">
    <div class="w4-card"><div class="w4-val" id="w4-copt">—</div><div class="w4-lbl">Teneur optimale (%)</div></div>
    <div class="w4-card"><div class="w4-val" id="w4-popt">—</div><div class="w4-lbl">Profit optimal ($/t)</div></div>
    <div class="w4-card"><div class="w4-val" id="w4-nat">—</div><div class="w4-lbl">Nature de la contrainte</div></div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(async function(){
  var $ = function(id){return document.getElementById(id);};

  // Attendre LaneUtils + Pyodide (defined par _lane_utils.qmd).
  while (!window.LaneUtils) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80)); }
  // Le widget peut avoir id='w4' ou 'w4-param' selon HTML — on prend le container.
  var rootEl = $('w4') || $('w4-param').closest('div');
  await window.LaneUtils.pret(rootEl);

  // Paramètres de base (02-07 defaults)
  var base = {
    y:0.87, p:600, k:0, m:1.32, h:3.41,
    f:11.9, F:0, M:12, H:3.9, K:0.15,
    moyenne:1.0, variance:4.0
  };

  // Plages de variation pour chaque paramètre
  var ranges = {
    p:   {min:200, max:1500, step:5, unit:'$/t'},
    k:   {min:0,   max:300,  step:5,  unit:'$/t'},
    m:   {min:0.1, max:3.5,  step:0.05,unit:'$/t'},
    h:   {min:0.25, max:10,   step:0.05,unit:'$/t'},
    y:   {min:0.3, max:1.0,  step:0.01,unit:''},
    f:   {min:0,   max:15,   step:0.5, unit:'M$'},
    F:   {min:0,   max:15,  step:0.5, unit:'M$'},
    M:   {min:2,   max:30,   step:0.5, unit:'Mt'},
    H:   {min:2,   max:15,   step:0.1, unit:'Mt'},
    K:   {min:0.3,max:0.2,  step:0.005,unit:'Mt'},
    moyenne: {min:0.1, max:4,    step:0.05,unit:'%'},
    variance:{min:0.4,max:10,step:0.1,  unit:'%²'}
  };

  function configSlider(param){
    var r = ranges[param];
    var sl = $('w4-slider');
    sl.min = 0; sl.max = 100; sl.step = 1;
    var bv = base[param];
    var frac = (bv - r.min) / (r.max - r.min);
    sl.value = Math.round(frac * 100);
  }

  function sliderToValue(param){
    var r = ranges[param];
    var frac = +$('w4-slider').value / 100;
    return r.min + frac * (r.max - r.min);
  }

  function drawChart(cvId, xs, datasets, opts){
    var cv=$(cvId), ctx=cv.getContext('2d');
    var W=cv.width, H=cv.height;
    var pad={l:52,r:12,t:24,b:34};
    var pw=W-pad.l-pad.r, ph=H-pad.t-pad.b;

    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#fff'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

    var xmin=opts.xmin, xmax=opts.xmax, ymin=opts.ymin, ymax=opts.ymax;
    function tx(x){return pad.l+(x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*pw;}
    function ty(y){return pad.t+(1-(y-ymin)/(ymax-ymin))*ph;}

    // Grid
    ctx.strokeStyle='#f0f0f0'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
    for(var i=0;i<=4;i++){var gy=ymin+i*(ymax-ymin)/4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.l,ty(gy));ctx.lineTo(pad.l+pw,ty(gy));ctx.stroke();}

    // Fill gray zone if vmin
    if(opts.vmin){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(180,180,180,0.15)';
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(tx(xs[0]),ty(ymin));
      for(var i=0;i<xs.length;i++) ctx.lineTo(tx(xs[i]),ty(opts.vmin[i]));
      ctx.lineTo(tx(xs[xs.length-1]),ty(ymin));ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
    }

    // Curves
    datasets.forEach(function(ds){
      ctx.strokeStyle=ds.color; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.setLineDash(ds.dash||[]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      for(var i=0;i<xs.length;i++){
        var px=tx(xs[i]),py=ty(ds.data[i]);
        i===0?ctx.moveTo(px,py):ctx.lineTo(px,py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
    });

    // Current value vertical
    if(opts.cx!==undefined){
      ctx.strokeStyle='#dc2626';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.setLineDash([6,3]);
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(tx(opts.cx),ty(ymin));ctx.lineTo(tx(opts.cx),ty(ymax));ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle='#333';ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad.l,pad.t);ctx.lineTo(pad.l,pad.t+ph);ctx.lineTo(pad.l+pw,pad.t+ph);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle='#333';ctx.font='11px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='right';
    for(var i=0;i<=4;i++){var gy=ymin+i*(ymax-ymin)/4;ctx.fillText(gy.toFixed(opts.ydec||1),pad.l-5,ty(gy)+4);}
    ctx.textAlign='center';
    for(var i=0;i<=4;i++){var gx=xmin+i*(xmax-xmin)/4;ctx.fillText(gx.toFixed(opts.xdec||2),tx(gx),pad.t+ph+15);}

    // Labels
    ctx.fillStyle='#111';ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(opts.title||'',pad.l+pw/2,15);
    ctx.fillStyle='#555';ctx.font='11px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText(opts.xlabel||'',pad.l+pw/2,H-3);

    // Legend
    var lx=pad.l+pw-8,ly=pad.t+14;
    ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.font='11px system-ui';
    datasets.forEach(function(ds,i){
      var yy=ly+i*16;
      ctx.strokeStyle=ds.color;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.setLineDash(ds.dash||[]);
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lx-55,yy);ctx.lineTo(lx-32,yy);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
      ctx.fillStyle=ds.color;ctx.fillText(ds.label,lx,yy+4);
    });
  }

  /** Adapter sortie Python → format historique (v1/v2/v3/vmin/cmax). */
  function _adapt(r){
    var cc = r.cc, v1 = r.v_mine, v2 = r.v_concentrateur, v3 = r.v_marche;
    var vmin = new Array(cc.length);
    for (var i=0;i<cc.length;i++) vmin[i] = Math.min(v1[i], v2[i], v3[i]);
    return Object.assign({}, r, {
      v1:v1, v2:v2, v3:v3, vmin:vmin,
      cmax: cc[cc.length-1],
      nature: r.nature_opt,
    });
  }

  let busy = false, redo = false;
  let curveCache = {param:null, pvals:[], copts:[], popts:[], cmin:0, cmax2:0, cm:0};
  async function update(){
    if (busy) { redo = true; return; }
    busy = true;
    try {
    var param = $('w4-param').value;
    var currentVal = sliderToValue(param);
    var r = ranges[param];
    $('w4-pval').textContent = param + ' = ' + currentVal.toFixed(r.step<0.1?2:r.step<1?1:0) + ' ' + r.unit;

    // Build params with current override
    var params = {};
    for(var key in base) params[key] = base[key];
    params[param] = currentVal;

    // --- Left panel: Lane curve for current value ---
    var res = _adapt(await window.LaneUtils.analyse_complete(params));
    var cc = res.cc;
    var yAll = res.v1.concat(res.v2, res.v3);
    var ymin=Infinity, ymax=-Infinity;
    for(var i=0;i<yAll.length;i++){if(isFinite(yAll[i])){if(yAll[i]<ymin)ymin=yAll[i];if(yAll[i]>ymax)ymax=yAll[i];}}
    var ym=(ymax-ymin)*0.08; ymin-=ym; ymax+=ym*2;

    drawChart('w4-cv1', cc, [
      {data:res.v1,color:'#2563eb',dash:[],label:'Mine'},
      {data:res.v2,color:'#ea580c',dash:[8,4],label:'Concentrateur'},
      {data:res.v3,color:'#16a34a',dash:[3,3],label:'Marché'}
    ], {xmin:0,xmax:res.cmax,ymin:ymin,ymax:ymax,title:'Courbes de profit',xlabel:'Teneur de coupure (%)',vmin:res.vmin,ydec:1});

    // --- Right panel: c_opt and profit_opt vs parameter value ---
    // La courbe ne dépend que de `param` (pas de currentVal) : on la calcule
    // une seule fois par changement de paramètre (cache), avec une résolution
    // élevée (N=60) pour une courbe lisse. Le déplacement du curseur ne fait
    // que redessiner avec une nouvelle ligne verticale (cx), sans recalcul.
    if (curveCache.param !== param) {
      var N=200;
      var pvals=[], copts=[], popts=[];
      for(var i=0;i<N;i++){
        var pv = r.min + i*(r.max-r.min)/(N-1);
        pvals.push(pv);
        var pp = {};
        for(var key in base) pp[key]=base[key];
        pp[param] = pv;
        var rr = await window.LaneUtils.analyse_complete(pp);
        copts.push(rr.c_opt);
        popts.push(rr.profit_opt);
      }

      var cmin=Infinity,cmax2=-Infinity;
      for(var i=0;i<copts.length;i++){if(isFinite(copts[i])&&copts[i]>0){if(copts[i]<cmin)cmin=copts[i];if(copts[i]>cmax2)cmax2=copts[i];}}
      var cm=(cmax2-cmin)*0.1; if(cm<0.01)cm=0.1;

      curveCache = {param:param, pvals:pvals, copts:copts, popts:popts, cmin:cmin, cmax2:cmax2, cm:cm};
    }

    drawChart('w4-cv2', curveCache.pvals, [
      {data:curveCache.copts,color:'#7c3aed',dash:[],label:'c_opt (%)'}
    ], {xmin:r.min,xmax:r.max,ymin:Math.max(0,curveCache.cmin-curveCache.cm),ymax:curveCache.cmax2+curveCache.cm,
        title:'Teneur optimale vs '+param,xlabel:param+' ('+r.unit+')',
        cx:currentVal,ydec:2,xdec:r.step<0.1?2:r.step<1?1:0});

    // Info cards
    $('w4-copt').textContent = isFinite(res.c_opt) ? res.c_opt.toFixed(2)+' %' : '—';
    $('w4-popt').textContent = isFinite(res.profit_opt) ? res.profit_opt.toFixed(2)+' $/t' : '—';
    $('w4-nat').textContent = res.nature;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[w4 sensibilite]', e);
      $('w4-copt').textContent = '⚠';
      $('w4-popt').textContent = e.message || 'erreur';
    } finally {
      busy = false;
      if (redo) { redo = false; update(); }
    }
  }

  $('w4-param').addEventListener('change', function(){
    configSlider($('w4-param').value);
    update();
  });
  $('w4-slider').addEventListener('input', update);

  configSlider('H');
  update();
})();
</script>
```
